title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-05-03
lineage: PCM (Sony SL-HF66) > Sony PCM-601ESD (analog outs) >Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) > KORG AudioGate 4 >Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: (Stage) Sony Stereo Mic > Master Reel > PCM

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording with killer sound; standout performances of He Was a Friend of Mine and The Other One.
ai_review.review: The stereo mic setup just off the stage delivers crystal‑clear, immersive audio that fans describe as ‘killer’. Both “He Was a Friend of Mine” and the sprawling “The Other One” are highlighted as great moments, despite Jerry’s guitar and the vocals sitting a bit low in the mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review, but it rates the show and recording at the top level (5 stars) and mentions strong performances and excellent sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo microphone just off stage gives killer sound; slight low‑mix on Jerry's guitar and vocals but overall tape is excellent.

standout_songs: He Was a Friend of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or pacing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar is a tad low in the mix, but performance noted as great.
